---
title: "QuestionSafe"
page-layout: article
---

QuestionSafe composes Moodle quiz questions and exports them as Moodle XML. Write questions
as Markdown files or build them in Python; categories, tags, idnumbers, cloze, and per-type
options map to Moodle's own features.

- [Quickstart](quickstart.qmd): install, and the two ways to write questions
- [Markdown Schema](markdown.qmd): every front-matter key and body syntax
- [Command Line](commandline.md): projects, templates, validation, courses
- [Python API](python.qmd): building questions and quizzes in Python
- [MetaChoice](metachoice.qmd): generating variants from a pool of choices
- [API Reference](api/index.qmd)

Note: "Moodle" is a trademark of Moodle Pty Ltd. This project is not affiliated with or
endorsed by Moodle.
